title: pyrus × kovalevii
intro: Pyrus × kovalevii, commonly known as the Kovalev's pear, is a hybrid plant species within the Rosaceae family, specifically a cross between Pyrus communis and Pyrus pyrifolia. The Kovalev's pear is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, thanks to its high content of antioxidants and polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus × kovalevii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, and act as a potential anti-cancer agent. The bioactive constituents of the Kovalev's pear include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
